groupings.title: MCP toolkit

groupings.title: Reticulum
groupings.description: Skills for Reticulum mesh networking, LXMF, LXMFy, the Go implementation, tooling and interface operation.

groupings.title: Nebula
groupings.description: Reference skill for the Nebula overlay network (slackhq/nebula): config, PKI, firewall, NAT traversal, relays and releases.

groupings.title: Self-hosted stack
groupings.description: Reference skills for self-hosted infrastructure: media automation, containers, mesh VPNs, messaging and PaaS. Documentation only, no MCP servers.

groupings.title: App development
groupings.description: Reference skills for application frameworks and platform APIs. Documentation only, no MCP servers.

groupings.title: Package managers
groupings.description: Skills for JS and Python package management and supply chain hardening: pnpm workspaces and lockfiles, uv, and Poetry.

groupings.title: Security
groupings.description: Security reference skills: OWASP standards and category lists, the local free/OSS scanning and linting tool catalog, threat hunting, blue teaming and SOC operations, OSINT, the Wazuh SIEM/XDR platform, and DevSecOps pipeline controls.

groupings.title: Engineering practice
groupings.description: Cross-cutting practice skills: software QA strategy and tooling, DevOps/platform engineering, disciplined technical research methods, microservices and HA design, and minimal project scaffolding.

groupings.title: Developer CLIs
groupings.description: Reference skills for source-control CLIs: GitHub CLI (gh) and the Gitea/Forgejo CLI (tea).

groupings.title: SurrealDB
groupings.description: Skills for SurrealDB: SurrealQL, vector search, SDKs, the CLI, SurrealKit migrations, and MCP integration.

groupings.description: Skills for each stdio MCP server in the repo.
